extracted.intended_audience: people who want to improve their speaking and get listeners' attention (presenters, speakers, communicators)
extracted.subtask_short: how to speak so people listen
extracted.subtask_description: A short instructional TED talk outlining practical techniques to make spoken communication more effective — including vocal exercises and approaches to connect with listeners emotionally.

rubrics_metrics.name: How-to's of powerful speaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on techniques and practices that make spoken communication powerful and compelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk demonstrates overall practices for 'powerful speaking' — a holistic aim that includes voice work, delivery, and connecting with listeners to make speech more effective and memorable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handy vocal exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical exercises to improve the quality, strength, and expressiveness of the speaker's voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page highlights that the speaker demonstrates vocal exercises; these are actionable practices intended to improve projection, clarity, tone, and vocal stamina as part of stronger delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tips on speaking with empathy
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on adopting an empathetic stance in speech to better connect with and engage listeners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk includes tips for speaking with empathy — i.e., tailoring tone, pacing, and content to listeners' perspectives and emotions so they feel heard and are more likely to listen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage listeners / solve 'nobody is listening' problem
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques and approaches aimed at overcoming the common experience of talking but not being listened to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk addresses the problem 'Have you ever felt like you're talking, but nobody is listening?' and provides practical remedies (voice work, empathetic delivery) to increase listener attention and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the world sound more beautiful (aspirational outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: An aspirational goal that better speaking can improve the soundscape and interpersonal communication in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed as a broader benefit: improving individual speaking skills contributes to a more pleasant/more attentive communicative environment; useful as a motivational criterion rather than a technical standard.
